description: It measures whether email from the site really sends, whether it lands in the inbox instead of the spam folder, and how fast it goes out, with one plain verdict for each point. Take it when a host says people did not get a mail. "Half of them say nothing arrived." Careful: a fresh measurement sends real email from the host's site, which is why this one is not read only. It measures only when the stored result is missing or older than 24 hours, and runs again only when it is told to. Nothing on the webinar changes. Side effect: it sends real email from your site. Words hosts use: mail not arriving, spam folder, delivery test, inbox

force.description: true measures even when a recent result exists.

run.description: true measures again now instead of reading the stored result. Sends real email.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id, as wi_list_webinars returned it.

title: Check whether the webinar emails really arrive
